    Selected work

    Evidence-grounded agent systems

    The work moves from measured decisions to model structure, agent behavior, constraint checks, and consequences in a coupled environment.

    Selected work

    From a problem to inspectable evidence

    A plausible AI decision is not necessarily a realistic or valid one. I compare it with human evidence, check its limits, and trace what happens next.

    01

    People and their environment

    Human surveys inform behavioral models; simulated households make adaptation choices under flood and resource constraints.

    Evidence

    02

    Evidence-linked scientific work

    AI research agents handle literature and tasks. I build tools that make sources, validation checks, and workflow state inspectable.

    Evidence

    Human respondents provide evidence. Simulated household agents and AI research agents are models and software, not people. These projects share a research approach, not one integrated published system.

    01

    Human-Grounded LLM Evaluation

    Can AI-generated flood-insurance answers reflect how real households make decisions?How I approached it I compared real household surveys with profile-based LLM responses using measurement checks, decision-pathway analysis, and repeated runs.What it contributes A way to detect differences in household variation and decision relationships that average answers alone can hide.    evaluation
    Methods
    Evaluation design · Psychometrics and SEM · Stability analysis
    Boundaries
    The interactive examples use synthetic records, not individual survey responses or research results.
    View case study: Human-Grounded LLM Evaluation
    02

    FLOODABM

    How do household choices change flood losses and the resources available next year?How I approached it I built the household decision model and connected adaptation choices to catastrophe, insurance, and financial mechanics.What it contributes A traceable link from household adaptation choices to losses, insurance outcomes, and resources in later years.    simulation
    Methods
    Agent-based modeling · Coupled simulation · Risk systems
    Boundaries
    Simulated household agents model adaptation; they are not an integrated LLM system.
    View case study: FLOODABM
    03

    WAGF

    What stops an invalid AI proposal from changing a simulation?How I approached it I designed the validation and repair path that checks an agent proposal before the simulation state can change.What it contributes An inspectable proposal-to-action boundary: invalid actions are blocked, repaired, and checked before execution.    governance
    Methods
    Structured outputs · Constraint validation · Auditable repair
    Boundaries
    Demonstrations illustrate validation behavior, not a real-world safety guarantee.
    View case study: WAGF
